subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should the exact-head dependency graph be authorized for moving Matrix QA dependency ownership from qa-matrix into QA Lab?
rationale: Repository policy deliberately blocks dependency-graph changes until an administrator or secops owner confirms that the ownership move and resolved lockfile graph are intentional; review automation cannot grant that authorization.

options.title: Authorize the ownership move
options.body: Approve the exact rebased head after confirming the existing workspace Matrix dependency and lockfile changes only transfer QA implementation ownership as intended.

options.title: Request a dependency-neutral redesign
options.body: Require the branch to retain dependency ownership in qa-matrix or use an already-approved boundary before the migration can proceed.

recommendation.title: Authorize the ownership move
recommendation.body: Approve the exact rebased head after confirming the existing workspace Matrix dependency and lockfile changes only transfer QA implementation ownership as intended.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository dependency guard explicitly assigns exact-head authorization for intentional dependency graph changes to repository administrators or this secops team.
